body:
Reproduced here. Bug is that the palette is still hanging around in the RGBA image:
```
(vpy27) erics@builder-16:~/test$ python -m pdb issue_2702.py
> /home/erics/test/issue_2702.py(1)<module>()
-> from PIL import Image
(Pdb) n
n
> /home/erics/test/issue_2702.py(2)<module>()
-> im = Image.open('issue_2702.png')
(Pdb) n
> /home/erics/test/issue_2702.py(3)<module>()
-> print im.mode # 'P'
(Pdb) n
P
> /home/erics/test/issue_2702.py(4)<module>()
-> im = im.convert('RGBA')
(Pdb) n
> /home/erics/test/issue_2702.py(5)<module>()
-> im = im.resize((320,240), Image.LANCZOS)
(Pdb) n
> /home/erics/test/issue_2702.py(6)<module>()
-> im.show()
[good image]
(Pdb) im
<PIL.Image.Image image mode=RGBA size=320x240 at 0x7F16BC7EAED0>
(Pdb) im.palette
<PIL.ImagePalette.ImagePalette object at 0x7f16bc7f7450>
(Pdb) im.palette = None
(Pdb) im.show()
[good image]
```

Workaround Code:
```python
from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('issue_2702.png')
print im.mode # 'P'
im = im.convert('RGBA')
im.palette = None
im = im.resize((320,240), Image.LANCZOS)
im = im.convert('P')
im.save('issue_2702.out.png')
```

issue.title: Delete transparency info when img.convert'ing RGB/L to RGBA
issue.body:
`info['transparency]` was not removed when an RGB or L image
was converted to RGBA. This could result in unexpected behavior
when saving the resulting image.

Other image conversions already delete or update the transparency
info. There is a shortcut for RGB/L to RGBA which missed this.

issue.title: Bug/ch331/fix bugs where color palette is messed up for some cropped images

repository.name: thumbor
repository.description: thumbor is an open-source photo thumbnail service by globo.com

issue.body:
This PR fixes a bug in Thumbor. Some of our source images are PNGs with mode 'P'. For these images, Thumbor converts from P to RGBA during resizing, and then converts back to P. However, this conversion from RGBA back to P causes color-banding and other artifacts, e.g. http://images.adrise.tv/4yYx2LrkRcXxx2MCOuR03ItDOmc=/214x306/smart/img.adrise.tv/46e01a0b-e372-4774-a13a-62b8ff471d89.png.

I've commented out this logic from Thumbor's code. It's not necessary for us, since we return all images from Thumbor as jpegs anyways. (Our optimizer converts any P images back to RGB, since P mode can't be saved as jpeg. See https://github.com/adRise/romantico/blob/master/optimizer/basic.py#L25).

I've tested out these changes a few images, and this works fine. In fact, the resulting images are smaller than with our current code. I'll keep testing more images. Also, I'm still trying to figure out how we'll deploy this out; may need to flush CDN cache. Meanwhile, please CR, @wanghaofei90.
